g.text: PR #2390 · Show Codex image, subagent and dynamic tool activity
Typed Codex items disappeared; visible cards now preserve their lifecycle identity.
New tool work receives matching activity ticks and tool-call metrics.
BEFORE
AFTER
render_item: AppServer falls through to None
ImageGeneration, SubAgentActivity, DynamicToolCall
and other valid items silently disappear.
render_extended_item: cards or diagnostics
Image, sub-agent, dynamic tool and plan cards.
Other typed items get a bounded JSON preview.
codex_item_id recognizes only three variants
New cards would repeat started/completed stages.
A raw fallback alone cannot fix grouping.
Every typed item retains its id
Lifecycle dedup keeps the final item card.
Unknown wire variants keep RawJson routing.
Visible work is missing from activity and metrics
WebSearch omitted from tool-call count.
App-server-only items have no sparkline tick.
item_counts_as_tool covers new tool work
Sub-agent starts count; later status updates do not.
Visible app-server cards get activity ticks.
Image bytes do not enter diagnostic previews.
Preview serialization stops after 4096 bytes.
Scope: image-generation status is visible; uploading image bytes and durable media references remain a separate follow-up.
